#   key   <vk hex> <mods> <verdict>      mods: bit 1 Ctrl, 2 Alt, 4 Shift, 8 Win
#   wheel <mods> <verdict>
#   click <button> <mods> <verdict>      button: 1/2 side, 3 left, 4 right, 5 middle
# Read by tests/test_keybind_rules.cpp (C++ rules) and ui/tests/keybind-rules.spec.js (UI mirror).
